question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**appears**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In blank 1 of the given passage, **the state of the sunlight is to be filled when the air is clear**.
 
• Let us explore the given options to decide which of them fits perfectly in the blank.
 
 
• **"Is" is a third person singular of the present tense of "be"**.** If we use 'is' in the blank, the sunset will be then declared to be yellow and the existence of other possibilities will be nullified. Hence, use of "is" is incorrect.**
 
• The** sentence is in present tense, hence the verb will be used in its base form**. Hence, option 3 and option 4 are incorrect.
 
• **We add "s" on the end of a verb in present tense **to agree with the singular "he," "she," or "it" subject, in this case "The sun".
 
 
 
• Thus, the word which will fill the blank is "appears".
 
• Hence, the **correct answer is option 2) appears**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Appears **means to come into sight and become visible.

 
 
• **Synonyms**: Emerge or to seem.
 
• **Example**: One by one the stars appeared in the sky.
